_meta.purpose: Pre-resolved registry values for downstream agents. Agents consuming this file do NOT need to load raw registry files.

spec_identity.notes: New spec family for exterior porch floor and patio coating. Context prefix PRFL (Porch FLoor) — no collision with existing prefixes (CLOSET_SHELF, FRAME, DOOR, CEIL, WALL, TRIM, WIN, STRS, WNSC, WDWL, WDCL, ARCH, BLTN, CABT, SDNG, FCSD, MSRY, DECK). Combined prime+finish in single spec. coating_system replaces quality_tier as primary dimension (same pattern as deck/fence specs). Dual-substrate single spec (concrete + wood). Epoxy excluded from v1. Anti-slip aggregate mandatory for all exterior floor coatings. No height modifier — ground-level work.

paintable_items.name: Exterior porch floor / patio floor surface
paintable_items.notes: New ITM for exterior porch/patio floor. SF-based — net porch floor area from PaintScope. Single item spec. Covers both concrete and wood substrates via substrate_type dimension. Horizontal surface with foot traffic, UV, and weather exposure. Production rates vary by coating_system, substrate_type, and application_method.

task_prefix.collision_check: No collision. Existing prefixes: CLOSET_SHELF/generic, FRAME, DOOR, CEIL, WALL, TRIM, WIN, STRS, WNSC, WDWL, WDCL, ARCH, BLTN, CABT, SDNG, FCSD, MSRY, DECK. PRFL is unique.
task_prefix.naming_rule: TSK_PRFL_{ACTION} — action should be verb-based. Examples: TSK_PRFL_MOISTURE_TEST, TSK_PRFL_ACID_ETCH, TSK_PRFL_PRIME_ROLL, TSK_PRFL_FINISH_ROLL_1, TSK_PRFL_ANTISLIP_BROADCAST, TSK_PRFL_PROTECT_WALL_BASE

expected_modules.notes: Protection setup — wall base perimeter masking, railing base masking (when_present), door threshold masking, landscape perimeter (when_adjacent), hardscape edge (when_adjacent)

Concrete prep — moisture testing (mandatory scheduling item), acid etch (muriatic acid + neutralizer), concrete patching, power wash/clean, profile verification. CONDITIONAL on substrate_type = concrete.
Wood prep — moisture testing, sanding (60-80 grit), dust removal, minor wood repair/filling. CONDITIONAL on substrate_type = wood.
Step prep — additional prep for step treads/risers including nosing detail, anti-slip texture prep. CONDITIONAL on has_steps = true. Applies to both substrates.

Primer application — alkali-resistant masonry primer (concrete + porch_enamel), exterior wood primer (wood + porch_enamel), polyurea manufacturer primer (concrete + polyurea), moisture-mitigating primer (concrete, contingency for failed moisture test). CONDITIONAL — acrylic_sealer and concrete_stain are self-priming/no-primer systems.
First finish coat — porch enamel, acrylic sealer, concrete stain, or polyurea topcoat per coating_system dimension.
Intercoat inspection, light sand if needed, dust removal. Anti-slip aggregate broadcast after first coat (mandatory for all systems). Drying time varies by coating_system.

Second finish coat. Required for porch_enamel (2 finish coats standard), acrylic_sealer (2 coats standard). Concrete_stain: sealer topcoat (different product than stain). Polyurea: optional second topcoat.
Sealer topcoat for concrete_stain system ONLY. Clear acrylic topcoat over stain. 1-2 coats. Separate module because it is a different material system than the stain itself.
Protection teardown, final inspection, anti-slip texture verification, tool cleaning, PPE disposal (acid etch waste).

paintscope_keys.description: Net porch/patio floor area (square feet). Primary measurement for all coating and material calculations.
Porch floor substrate type (concrete/wood). Drives primer selection, prep module activation, and coating system compatibility.

Porch floor coating system (porch_enamel/concrete_stain/acrylic_sealer/polyurea). Primary configuration dimension — replaces quality_tier. Drives material selection, round configuration, and production rates.
Boolean flag confirming new construction context. Always true for this NC spec.
Boolean flag indicating porch has steps. Activates MOD_PRFL_PREP_STEPS and step-specific tasks within finish modules.
Count of porch steps (tread + riser = 1 step). Used when has_steps = true. Step area included in total porch floor SF.
Porch exposure type (covered_porch/open_patio). Drives environmental exposure modifier and drying time considerations.
Linear feet of wall base perimeter adjacent to porch floor requiring masking protection.
Linear feet of railing base requiring masking protection. Conditional — when_present.
Count of door thresholds requiring masking. Always present — at least 1 entry door.
Linear feet of landscape perimeter adjacent to porch requiring protection. Conditional — when_adjacent.
Linear feet of adjacent hardscape edge (walkway, driveway) requiring protection. Conditional — when_adjacent.

coating_system.notes: PRIMARY CONFIGURATION DIMENSION — replaces quality_tier for this spec. porch_enamel: both substrates (concrete + wood). concrete_stain: concrete only, requires separate sealer topcoat. acrylic_sealer: concrete only, self-priming breathable sealer. polyurea: concrete only, highest durability. Epoxy excluded per KD-001. Proposed new enum type for controlled_enums.json.

substrate_type.notes: Dual-substrate spec per KD-003. Concrete is ~80% of residential porches. Wood porches share porch_enamel coating system. substrate_type drives primer selection, prep module activation, and coating system compatibility (concrete_stain/acrylic_sealer/polyurea are concrete-only).

exposure_type.notes: Drives environmental exposure modifier. Open patio has full UV/rain exposure — may affect drying time scheduling and maintenance expectations. Covered porch has partial protection.

application_method.notes: Roll is primary for floor coatings (3/8-3/4 nap). brush_roll for detail areas, steps, edges. spray_backroll for large open patios. Spray-only prohibited — backroll mandatory on floor surfaces to ensure film integrity and anti-slip adhesion.

phase.notes: Combined prime+finish spec. Prime module conditional (acrylic_sealer and concrete_stain skip primer). Interstage includes mandatory anti-slip aggregate broadcast.

task_classification.notes: binary: same rate all coating systems. cs_conditional: task only appears for certain coating systems (e.g., acid etch for concrete only, sealer topcoat for concrete_stain only). cs_scaled: task rate varies by coating system complexity. Note: 'cs_' prefix for coating_system-driven classification (parallel to ct_ for deck coating_type, qt_ for quality_tier).

unit_of_measure.notes: SF is primary UOM for porch floor field. EA for door thresholds, step count, protection items. LF for wall base perimeter, railing base, landscape/hardscape edge. FIXED for moisture testing, tool cleaning.

substrate_state.notes: SS_EXT_BARE_MASONRY for concrete substrates, SS_EXT_BARE_WOOD for wood substrates. Both are NC input states. Output varies by coating_system: porch enamel and acrylic sealer produce satin finish, concrete stain produces semi-transparent stained state, polyurea produces semi-gloss film.

product_role.notes: primer: alkali-resistant masonry primer, exterior wood primer, polyurea basecoat, moisture-mitigating primer. finish: porch enamel, acrylic sealer, polyurea topcoat. stain: concrete stain (penetrating). sealer: clear acrylic topcoat for concrete stain. specialty: anti-slip aggregate.

protection_level.notes: Exterior floor zones. edge_only for wall base with brush/roll. Upgrades to light_mask when spray_backroll. full_cover for adjacent hardscape/landscape when spraying.

surface_ids.notes: porch_floor_field is proposed — new surface ID for porch/patio floor. ext_wall_base, ext_railing_base, ext_door_threshold describe protection-adjacent surfaces.

zone_ids.notes: Wall base perimeter adjacent to porch floor. LF-based. Always present.
Railing base on porch. LF-based. Conditional — when_present.
Door threshold at porch entry. EA-based. Always present.
Landscape adjacent to porch edge. LF-based. Conditional — when_adjacent.
Hardscape (walkway/driveway) adjacent to porch edge. LF-based. Conditional — when_adjacent.

existing_systems_to_consider: SYS_EXT_MSRY_PRIMER_ALKALI — alkali-resistant masonry primer. Could potentially share for concrete substrate + porch_enamel, but coverage rates differ on floor vs wall (horizontal pooling risk).
SYS_PRIMER_WOOD_EXT — exterior wood primer referenced in research. May be existing or proposed.

proposed_systems.name: Alkali-Resistant Masonry Primer (for concrete porch floors)
proposed_systems.notes: Mandatory on bare concrete substrate when using porch enamel finish. Same chemistry as SYS_EXT_MSRY_PRIMER_ALKALI but different coverage rates on horizontal concrete floor (smoother surface, potential for pooling). Reference: SW Loxon Masonry Primer.

proposed_systems.name: Exterior Wood Primer (for wood porch floors)
proposed_systems.notes: Standard exterior wood primer for bare wood porch flooring. Acrylic latex exterior primer. Coverage: 300-400 SF/gal on smooth wood.

proposed_systems.name: Acrylic Porch & Floor Enamel
proposed_systems.notes: Both substrates (concrete + wood). Heavy-duty acrylic floor enamel designed for foot traffic. Satin sheen standard. 2 finish coats. Reference: SW Porch & Floor Enamel, BM Floor & Patio. Coverage: 350-450 SF/gal.

proposed_systems.name: Breathable Acrylic Sealer (concrete only)
proposed_systems.notes: Self-priming breathable acrylic sealer — no separate primer needed. Allows moisture vapor transmission. 2 coats standard. Coverage: 200-350 SF/gal depending on concrete porosity.

proposed_systems.name: Penetrating Concrete Stain (concrete only)
proposed_systems.notes: Penetrating concrete stain — no primer, stain absorbs into concrete. 1-2 stain coats. Requires separate sealer topcoat (SYS_FINISH_SEALER_TOPCOAT). Coverage: 200-400 SF/gal depending on concrete porosity and profile.

proposed_systems.name: Clear Acrylic Topcoat Sealer (for concrete stain)
proposed_systems.notes: Clear acrylic topcoat sealer applied over concrete stain. Provides wear protection and UV resistance. 1-2 coats. Mandatory per KD-009. Coverage: 300-500 SF/gal.

proposed_systems.name: Polyurea/Polyaspartic Floor Coating (concrete only)
proposed_systems.notes: High-performance polyurea/polyaspartic coating. Highest durability, chemical resistance, UV stability. Fast cure (4-8 hours walk-on). 1-2 topcoats. Coverage: 200-300 SF/gal. Requires manufacturer-specific primer.

proposed_systems.name: Polyurea Manufacturer-Specific Basecoat/Primer (concrete only)
proposed_systems.notes: Manufacturer-paired primer/basecoat for polyurea system. Must match topcoat manufacturer for adhesion warranty. Coverage: 200-350 SF/gal.

proposed_systems.name: Moisture-Mitigating Primer (contingency for failed moisture test)
proposed_systems.notes: Contingency product — used only when concrete fails ASTM D4263 moisture test. Allows coating application on concrete with elevated moisture. Scheduling item per KD-006. Coverage: 200-300 SF/gal.

material_system_prefix.notes: 9 material systems total: 3 primers (alkali masonry, wood ext, polyurea manufacturer) + 1 contingency primer (moisture mitigating) + 4 finish/topcoat products (porch enamel, acrylic sealer, concrete stain, polyurea) + 1 sealer topcoat (for concrete stain). Anti-slip aggregate is a consumable, not a material system.

proposed_consumables.name: Roller Cover 3/8 inch nap (smooth concrete/wood floor)
proposed_consumables.notes: Short nap roller for smooth porch floor coating. 9-inch width standard. For porch enamel, acrylic sealer, and sealer topcoat on smooth surfaces.

proposed_consumables.name: Roller Cover 1/2-3/4 inch nap (textured/broom-finished concrete)
proposed_consumables.notes: Medium nap roller for textured concrete surfaces. Broom-finished or exposed aggregate concrete requires thicker nap for coverage in texture valleys.

proposed_consumables.name: Roller Frame 9 inch
proposed_consumables.notes: Standard 9-inch roller frame for floor coating application.

proposed_consumables.name: Extension Pole 4-8 ft (floor roller application)
proposed_consumables.notes: Extension pole for stand-up roller application. Reduces fatigue on large floor areas. Reusable tool tracked as consumable.

proposed_consumables.name: Paint Tray / Liner (floor coating)
proposed_consumables.notes: Standard paint tray and liner for roller loading. Replace liner between primer and finish coats.

proposed_consumables.name: Angled Brush 2-3 inch (cut-in / edge work)
proposed_consumables.notes: Angled sash brush for cutting in at wall base, railing base, and threshold edges.

proposed_consumables.name: Airless Spray Tip 517 (floor coating spray_backroll)
proposed_consumables.notes: 0.017 orifice for floor coating spray application. Used with spray_backroll method on large open patios.

proposed_consumables.name: Silica Sand 30-60 Mesh (anti-slip aggregate)
proposed_consumables.notes: Anti-slip aggregate — broadcast into wet coating per KD-005. 30-60 mesh silica sand is standard. Mandatory for all exterior floor coatings. 1 EA = ~5 lb bag per ~200 SF.

proposed_consumables.name: Aluminum Oxide 36-60 Grit (premium anti-slip aggregate)
proposed_consumables.notes: Premium anti-slip aggregate — aluminum oxide provides superior traction and durability vs silica sand. More expensive but longer lasting. 1 EA = ~5 lb bag per ~200 SF.

proposed_consumables.name: Muriatic Acid (concrete etch / profile)
proposed_consumables.notes: Muriatic acid (hydrochloric acid) for concrete surface profiling. Dilute 1:3 to 1:4 with water. Creates mechanical bond profile on smooth concrete. Coverage: ~100 SF/gal diluted. PPE mandatory: acid-resistant gloves, goggles, respirator.

proposed_consumables.name: Acid Neutralizer (TSP or baking soda)
proposed_consumables.notes: Neutralizer for muriatic acid etch. TSP (trisodium phosphate) or baking soda solution. Must neutralize fully before priming — pH test with litmus paper. 1 EA = sufficient for ~500 SF.

proposed_consumables.name: Concrete Patching Compound
proposed_consumables.notes: Hydraulic or polymer-modified concrete patching compound for spalls, cracks, and surface defects. Must cure per manufacturer spec before coating.

proposed_consumables.name: Sandpaper 60 Grit (wood floor prep)
proposed_consumables.notes: Coarse grit for wood porch floor prep. 60-80 grit range for initial sanding of bare wood.

proposed_consumables.name: Sandpaper 80 Grit (wood floor prep / intercoat)
proposed_consumables.notes: Medium grit for wood floor final prep and intercoat sanding.

proposed_consumables.name: Masking Tape 1.5-2 inch (wall base / railing base / threshold)
proposed_consumables.notes: Standard blue or green masking tape for perimeter protection. UV-resistant for exterior use. Tape at wall base, railing base, and door threshold.

proposed_consumables.name: Masking Paper 12-18 inch (wall base drape)
proposed_consumables.notes: Masking paper draped from tape line to protect wall base from roller splash and spray overspray.

proposed_consumables.name: Plastic Sheeting 4 mil (landscape/hardscape protection)
proposed_consumables.notes: Plastic sheeting for landscape and hardscape edge protection. 4 mil minimum for durability.

proposed_consumables.name: Acid-Resistant Gloves (acid etch PPE)
proposed_consumables.notes: Chemical-resistant gloves for muriatic acid etch. Neoprene or PVC. Mandatory PPE for acid etch task.

proposed_consumables.name: Chemical Splash Goggles (acid etch PPE)
proposed_consumables.notes: Splash-proof goggles for acid etch. Mandatory PPE.

proposed_consumables.name: Acid Vapor Respirator (acid etch PPE)
proposed_consumables.notes: Half-mask respirator with acid gas cartridges for muriatic acid etch. Mandatory PPE when etching in covered/enclosed porch areas.

proposed_configurations.description: 1 alkali-resistant primer + 2 finish coats (porch enamel) = 3 rounds — concrete substrate
proposed_configurations.notes: Standard porch enamel on concrete. Primer mandatory (alkali-resistant). 2 finish coats with anti-slip aggregate broadcast after coat 1. Full dry between coats.

proposed_configurations.description: 1 exterior wood primer + 2 finish coats (porch enamel) = 3 rounds — wood substrate
proposed_configurations.notes: Standard porch enamel on wood. Wood primer mandatory. 2 finish coats with anti-slip aggregate broadcast after coat 1.
Self-priming acrylic sealer — no separate primer. 2 coats standard. Anti-slip aggregate broadcast after coat 1.

proposed_configurations.description: 1-2 stain coats + 1-2 sealer topcoats = 2-4 rounds — concrete substrate
proposed_configurations.notes: No primer — stain penetrates directly. 1-2 stain coats depending on desired color depth. 1-2 clear acrylic sealer topcoats per KD-009. Anti-slip aggregate broadcast into final sealer coat.

proposed_configurations.description: 1 manufacturer primer + 1-2 topcoats = 2-3 rounds — concrete substrate
proposed_configurations.notes: Manufacturer-specific primer/basecoat + 1-2 polyurea topcoats. Fast cure (4-8 hr walk-on). Anti-slip aggregate broadcast into final topcoat. Must match manufacturer system for warranty.

proposed_profiles.description: Alkali-resistant primer on bare concrete floor — 300-400 SF/gal. Smoother than vertical masonry wall, less porosity variance.
Exterior wood primer on bare wood porch floor — 300-400 SF/gal on smooth planed wood.
Polyurea manufacturer basecoat/primer on profiled concrete — 200-350 SF/gal.
Porch & floor enamel on primed surface — 350-450 SF/gal. Both concrete and wood substrates.
Breathable acrylic sealer on concrete — 200-350 SF/gal. Higher absorption on first coat, better coverage on second.
Penetrating concrete stain — 200-400 SF/gal depending on concrete porosity and surface profile.
Clear acrylic topcoat sealer over concrete stain — 300-500 SF/gal.
Polyurea/polyaspartic topcoat on primed concrete — 200-300 SF/gal.

cross_spec_coordination.notes: Door and window protection at porch perimeter is NOT this spec's responsibility. Railing painting (if any) would be a separate spec scope. Steps are included in this spec's scope via has_steps flag. No cross-spec flags needed.

proposed_modifiers.description: Production rate modifier by coating system (primary dimension)
proposed_modifiers.notes: Porch enamel is baseline (1.00) — standard acrylic floor paint, familiar application. Concrete stain is faster (penetrating, less film management). Acrylic sealer slightly faster (self-priming, thin coats). Polyurea is slower (fast-curing requires speed and precision, pot-life management, manufacturer-specific technique).

proposed_modifiers.description: Production rate modifier by substrate type
proposed_modifiers.notes: Concrete is baseline. Wood slightly slower due to grain management, edge work, and absorption control on end-grain at board joints.

proposed_modifiers.description: Modifier for exposure type affecting scheduling and protection
proposed_modifiers.notes: Covered porch is baseline. Open patio has slight overhead for weather window management, UV-accelerated dry time monitoring, and additional hardscape/landscape protection. Per RC-001: environmental conditions excluded from rate modifiers — this modifier reflects protection/logistics overhead only, not weather delays.

No steps is baseline. Steps add per-step detail work (nosing, risers, edge taping, anti-slip on treads). Modifier applies to overall job, not per-SF. Step count is a secondary input for more precise estimation within the module.

materials_json.coating_system_note: Material systems branch by coating_system (not quality_tier). Multiple product_roles in play: primer, finish, stain, sealer, specialty. Anti-slip aggregate is a consumable, not a material system.

production_json.coating_system_note: Production rates vary by coating_system instead of quality_tier. Use rates_by_coating_system instead of rates_by_tier.

cross_file_threading: RULE 1: Every TSK_ in sop_modules.json MUST have a matching rate in production.json
RULE 2: Every ITM_ in spec.json MUST appear in at least one variant
RULE 3: Every SYS_ coating_system MUST match spec.json configuration_dimensions (coating_system replaces quality_tier for this spec)
RULE 4: Every IN_ input in spec.json SHOULD be consumed by sop_modules or production
RULE 5: Every PS_ key in production.json MUST match spec.json required_paintscope_inputs
RULE 6: Every zone_id in spec.json MUST match sop_modules.json protection_metadata.zones
RULE 7: Module phase order: setup → prep → prime → interstage → finish → cleanup
RULE 8: UOM for a task MUST match between sop_modules.json and production.json
RULE 9: All TSK_ IDs MUST use TSK_PRFL_ prefix (from this resolution)
RULE 10: ITM_PORCH_FLOOR MUST be used exactly as registered (proposed ID)
RULE 11: Downstream agents MUST use only enum values from this resolution's applicable_enums
RULE 12: Anti-slip aggregate broadcast task MUST appear in interstage module (mandatory per KD-005)
RULE 13: Concrete stain system MUST include separate sealer topcoat module (per KD-009)
RULE 14: Prime module is CONDITIONAL — acrylic_sealer and concrete_stain skip primer

registry_additions_proposed.name: Exterior Porch & Patio Floor Coating (Concrete + Wood, New Construction)
registry_additions_proposed.justification: New spec family for exterior porch/patio floor coating. Distinct from deck (horizontal foot traffic like deck, but different substrates — concrete primary, dual-substrate). Distinct from masonry wall (horizontal vs vertical, different production rates). Coating_system as primary dimension (porch_enamel, concrete_stain, acrylic_sealer, polyurea). Epoxy excluded v1.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Exterior porch floor / patio floor surface
registry_additions_proposed.justification: No existing ITM covers exterior porch/patio floor surfaces. Distinct from ITM_DECK_FLOOR (deck is wood-only, stain-based; porch is dual-substrate, paint/coating-based). Distinct from any interior floor items.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Exterior porch/patio floor field surface
registry_additions_proposed.justification: New surface vocabulary entry. No existing surface_id covers porch/patio floor field. Distinct from deck_floor_field (different substrate class and coating system).

registry_additions_proposed.name: Wall base perimeter adjacent to porch floor (LF-based)
registry_additions_proposed.justification: New zone for porch-specific wall base protection. Similar to generic wall base but specific to porch floor scope.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Railing base on porch floor (LF-based, when_present)
registry_additions_proposed.justification: New zone for railing base protection on porch. Railing base contacts floor coating — requires tape masking.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Door threshold at porch entry (EA-based)
registry_additions_proposed.justification: New zone for door threshold protection. Threshold is the transition between porch floor and interior — requires careful masking to maintain clean edge.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Landscape adjacent to porch edge (LF-based, when_adjacent)
registry_additions_proposed.justification: New zone for landscape protection at porch perimeter. Per RC-002: LF not SF for landscape/hardscape protection.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Hardscape edge adjacent to porch (LF-based, when_adjacent)
registry_additions_proposed.justification: New zone for hardscape edge protection. Per RC-002: LF not SF.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Porch Floor Surface Area (SF)
registry_additions_proposed.justification: New PS key for porch floor net area. No existing PS key covers porch/patio floor surfaces.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Porch Floor Substrate Type Enum (concrete/wood)
registry_additions_proposed.justification: New PS key for porch substrate type. Generic SUBSTRATE_TYPE key — may be shared across specs that need substrate type selection.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Porch Floor Coating System Enum (porch_enamel/concrete_stain/acrylic_sealer/polyurea)
registry_additions_proposed.justification: New PS key for coating system selection. Primary configuration dimension for this spec.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Porch Has Steps Boolean Flag
registry_additions_proposed.justification: New PS key for step presence. Activates step prep and finish tasks.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Porch Step Count (EA)
registry_additions_proposed.justification: New PS key for step count. Used when has_steps = true for per-step task estimation.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Porch Exposure Type Enum (covered_porch/open_patio)
registry_additions_proposed.justification: New PS key for exposure type selection. Drives scheduling and protection modifier.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Wall Base Perimeter Protection (LF)
registry_additions_proposed.justification: New PS key for wall base masking perimeter at porch floor edge.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Railing Base Protection (LF, when_present)
registry_additions_proposed.justification: New PS key for railing base masking at porch floor.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Door Threshold Protection (EA)
registry_additions_proposed.justification: New PS key for door threshold masking count.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Hardscape Edge Protection (LF, when_adjacent)
registry_additions_proposed.justification: New PS key for hardscape edge protection at porch perimeter.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Alkali-Resistant Masonry Primer (for concrete porch floors)
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Referenced from research. May overlap with SYS_EXT_MSRY_PRIMER_ALKALI but different coverage context (horizontal floor vs vertical wall). Used for concrete substrate + porch_enamel coating system.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Exterior Wood Primer (for wood porch floors)
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Referenced from research. Standard exterior acrylic wood primer for bare wood porch flooring.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Acrylic Porch & Floor Enamel
registry_additions_proposed.justification: New material system — no existing SYS covers porch/floor enamel products. Heavy-duty acrylic floor enamel for foot traffic. Both concrete and wood substrates.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Breathable Acrylic Sealer (concrete only)
registry_additions_proposed.justification: New material system for breathable acrylic concrete sealer. Self-priming, allows moisture vapor transmission.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Penetrating Concrete Stain
registry_additions_proposed.justification: New material system for penetrating concrete stain. Distinct from deck stain products — concrete stain is a different chemistry (reactive/acid stain or penetrating).

registry_additions_proposed.name: Clear Acrylic Topcoat Sealer (for concrete stain)
registry_additions_proposed.justification: New material system for clear topcoat over concrete stain per KD-009. Separate product from the stain itself.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Polyurea/Polyaspartic Floor Coating
registry_additions_proposed.justification: New material system for polyurea/polyaspartic floor coating. High-performance, fast-cure. Concrete only.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Polyurea Manufacturer-Specific Basecoat/Primer
registry_additions_proposed.justification: New material system for polyurea system primer. Must match topcoat manufacturer.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Moisture-Mitigating Primer (contingency)
registry_additions_proposed.justification: New material system for contingency moisture-mitigating primer. Used only when concrete fails ASTM D4263 moisture test per KD-006.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Alkali-Resistant Primer Coverage on Concrete Floor
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Porch floor primer coverage differs from masonry wall (smoother horizontal surface). 300-400 SF/gal.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Exterior Wood Primer Coverage on Porch Floor
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Wood porch floor primer coverage. 300-400 SF/gal on smooth planed wood.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Polyurea Primer Coverage on Profiled Concrete
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Polyurea basecoat coverage on acid-etched concrete. 200-350 SF/gal.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Moisture-Mitigating Primer Coverage on Concrete
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Contingency primer coverage. 200-300 SF/gal.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Porch & Floor Enamel Coverage
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Porch enamel coverage on primed surface. 350-450 SF/gal.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Breathable Acrylic Sealer Coverage on Concrete
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Acrylic sealer coverage. 200-350 SF/gal depending on porosity.
